caption: The drawing depicts a wooden birdhouse with a rustic appearance, rendered in muted tones of brown and gray. The birdhouse consists of a rectangular box with a flat, slightly uneven top that has a rough edge, adding to its weathered look. The front of the birdhouse is divided into two sections: the upper part features a narrow rectangular slot, and below it, there is a circular entrance hole surrounded by a lighter wood grain pattern. The sides and the visible part of the back are made from wood planks, and the texture and grain of the wood are clearly illustrated throughout the structure. The birdhouse is centered on a plain, light-beige background, and the name “ROSE CAMPBELL” is inscribed in small, neat letters to the right of the base of the birdhouse.
title: Mail Box
